name: Langfuse
description: Let your AI read a Langfuse project: LLM traces, observations and sessions with cost, tokens and latency, metrics over time, scores and evaluations, prompts with their versions and labels, datasets, dataset items and experiments; it can also publish prompt versions, move labels, add scores and build datasets.
prerequisites: A Langfuse project on Langfuse Cloud (EU, US, Japan or HIPAA) or on a self-hosted Langfuse v4, and a project API key pair (public and secret key) from the project settings. About 3 minutes.

LANGFUSE_HOST.label: Langfuse address
LANGFUSE_HOST.help: https://cloud.langfuse.com for Cloud EU, https://us.cloud.langfuse.com for Cloud US, https://jp.cloud.langfuse.com for Cloud Japan, https://hipaa.cloud.langfuse.com for HIPAA US, or your self-hosted address as you open it in the browser. Without a trailing slash or path.
LANGFUSE_HOST.patternMessage: Use https://cloud.langfuse.com, https://us.cloud.langfuse.com, another Langfuse Cloud region or your self-hosted address (https://...), without a trailing slash or path.

LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY.label: Public key
LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY.help: Langfuse, Project settings, API Keys, Create new API keys. The public key starts with pk-lf-.
LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the public key as Langfuse shows it, starting with pk-lf-.

LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY.label: Secret key
LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY.help: Shown once next to the public key when the key pair is created; it starts with sk-lf-.
LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the secret key as Langfuse shows it, starting with sk-lf-.

verifyHints.401: Langfuse refused the key pair. Check that the public and secret key belong together and to this address: keys of Cloud EU do not work on Cloud US and the other way round.
verifyHints.403: This key pair may not use this endpoint. Use a project-scoped API key from the project settings, not an organization key.
verifyHints.404: The Langfuse address answers but this endpoint is missing. Self-hosted Langfuse must be v4 or later for the v2 observations and metrics endpoints.

instructions:
## Langfuse
This connector uses the **Langfuse Public API** (`<LANGFUSE_HOST>/api/public`) of one Langfuse project: LLM observability (traces, observations and sessions with model, tokens, cost and latency), metrics, scores, prompt management, datasets and experiments. It works with Langfuse Cloud (EU, US, Japan, HIPAA) and self-hosted Langfuse v4.

**Setup (3 minutes)**
1. In Langfuse open the project, then **Settings, API Keys, Create new API keys**.
2. Copy the **public key** (`pk-lf-...`) into `LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY` and the **secret key** (`sk-lf-...`, shown once) into `LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY`. They are sent as HTTP Basic auth.
3. Set `LANGFUSE_HOST` to the region the project lives in: `https://cloud.langfuse.com` (EU), `https://us.cloud.langfuse.com` (US), `https://jp.cloud.langfuse.com` (Japan), `https://hipaa.cloud.langfuse.com` (HIPAA), or the self-hosted address.
4. Run `langfuse_get_project` to check the keys; `langfuse_get_health` shows the server version.

**Langfuse's own MCP server**: Langfuse also runs a native MCP server at `<LANGFUSE_HOST>/api/public/mcp` (same Basic auth key pair), mainly for prompt management. This connector covers prompts too, plus tracing data, metrics, scores and datasets.

**Tracing data (observations-first)**: in Langfuse v4 a trace is the set of observations (spans, generations, tool calls, events) that share a `traceId`, and a session is the set of traces that share a `sessionId`. The old `/traces`, `/sessions` and `/metrics/daily` endpoints are deprecated (Langfuse Cloud serves them until 16 November 2026), so this connector reads everything from Observations API v2 and Metrics API v2, the only real-time read path. Other endpoints can lag about 10 minutes behind ingestion.
- `langfuse_list_observations`: rows newest first. Always bound it with `from_start_time` and `to_start_time` (ISO 8601, UTC). Filter by `type` (GENERATION for LLM calls), `name`, `user_id`, `session_id`, `trace_id`, `level` (ERROR for failures), `environment`, `is_root_observation` (true gives one row per trace, the trace's entry point), or a structured `filter`. `fields` picks the field groups: `core` (always), `basic`, `time`, `io` (input and output), `metadata`, `model`, `usage` (tokens and cost), `prompt`, `metrics` (latency), `trace_context` (trace name, tags, release).
- `langfuse_get_trace`: every observation of one trace with input, output, model, usage and latency. Rebuild the tree with `parentObservationId`; the root has none. Trace-level input and output are those of the root observation.
- `langfuse_get_session`: the traces of one session (one row per trace by default), oldest conversation turns last.
- `langfuse_query_metrics`: aggregates such as cost per model per day. `query` is a JSON string, e.g. `{"view": "observations", "metrics": [{"measure": "totalCost", "aggregation": "sum"}, {"measure": "count", "aggregation": "count"}], "dimensions": [{"field": "providedModelName"}], "timeDimension": {"granularity": "day"}, "filters": [], "fromTimestamp": "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z", "toTimestamp": "2026-10-31T00:00:00Z"}`. Views: `observations`, `scores-numeric`, `scores-boolean`, `scores-categorical`. Observation measures: `count`, `latency`, `streamingLatency`, `inputTokens`, `outputTokens`, `totalTokens`, `inputCost`, `outputCost`, `totalCost`, `timeToFirstToken`, `countScores`; aggregations `sum`, `avg`, `count`, `max`, `min`, `p50`, `p75`, `p90`, `p95`, `p99`. Dimensions include `environment`, `type`, `name`, `level`, `tags`, `release`, `traceName`, `providedModelName`, `promptName`, `promptVersion`. High-cardinality fields such as `userId` and `sessionId` can be filtered on but not grouped by.

**Scores and evaluations**: `langfuse_list_scores` (filter by `name`, `source` API, ANNOTATION or EVAL, `data_type`, `trace_id`, `session_id`, `observation_id`, `experiment_id`, value range, time range); `langfuse_list_score_configs` for the score definitions; `langfuse_create_score` adds one score (numeric, boolean as 0 or 1, categorical or text) to a trace, observation, session or experiment run. Scores are processed asynchronously.

**Prompts**: `langfuse_list_prompts` (names with versions, labels and tags), `langfuse_get_prompt` (the version labelled `production` unless `version` or `label` is given). `langfuse_create_prompt_version` publishes a new version of a text or chat prompt (a new name creates the prompt); `langfuse_update_prompt_labels` moves deployment labels such as `production` or `staging` to a version. Prompt names with folders (`support/greeting`) are passed as they are. Changing the `production` label changes what applications fetch: **confirm with the user first**.

**Datasets and experiments**: `langfuse_list_datasets`, `langfuse_get_dataset`, `langfuse_create_dataset`; `langfuse_list_dataset_items`, `langfuse_get_dataset_item`, `langfuse_upsert_dataset_item` (creates an item, or updates it when `item_id` exists; `status` ARCHIVED hides it from new runs). `langfuse_list_experiments` lists dataset runs and experiments with their scores (`from_start_time` is required).

**Reading answers**: times are ISO 8601, UTC. Costs are USD; in v2 observations `inputPrice`, `outputPrice` and `totalPrice` are strings (decimal precision), `input` and `output` arrive as JSON text to parse. Latency and time to first token are milliseconds in metrics.

**Paging**: observations, scores and experiments use cursors: pass `meta.cursor` back as `cursor` until it is missing. Prompts, datasets, dataset items and score configs use `page` (from 1) and `limit`; `meta.totalPages` says how many pages exist.

**Not included**: deleting traces, prompts, datasets or scores, annotation queues, organization and SCIM administration, LLM connections, and ingestion (traces are sent by the Langfuse SDKs over OpenTelemetry).

**Errors**: 400 bad parameter (a malformed `filter` or `query` JSON, a group-by on a high-cardinality field, `limit` over the maximum); 401 wrong key pair or wrong region; 403 the key may not use this endpoint; 404 unknown prompt, dataset or item, or a self-hosted version without the v2 endpoints; 429 rate limited (wait, do not loop).

tools.name: langfuse_get_project
tools.description: Show the Langfuse project this key pair belongs to: id, name, organization and retention settings. Use it to check the connection.

tools.name: langfuse_get_health
tools.description: Check that the Langfuse server and its database are up and read the Langfuse version (v4 or later is needed for the observation and metrics tools).

tools.name: langfuse_list_observations
tools.description: List observations (LLM generations, spans, tool calls, events) of the Langfuse project, newest first, with the chosen field groups. Bound it with from_start_time and to_start_time. Page with cursor = meta.cursor until it is missing.

from_start_time.description: Only observations that started at or after this ISO 8601 time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

to_start_time.description: Only observations that started before this ISO 8601 time.

fields.description: Comma-separated field groups: core, basic, time, io, metadata, model, usage, prompt, metrics, trace_context. Default core,basic,usage; add io for input and output.

type.description: Observation type: GENERATION, SPAN, EVENT, AGENT, TOOL, CHAIN, RETRIEVER, EVALUATOR, EMBEDDING, GUARDRAIL.

user_id.description: Only observations of this user id.

session_id.description: Only observations of this session id.

trace_id.description: Only observations of this trace id.

level.description: Only observations with this level; ERROR finds failures.

is_root_observation.description: true: only the entry point of each trace (one row per trace).

filter.description: Structured filter as a JSON string, overriding the simple filters: [{"type": "string", "column": "traceName", "operator": "=", "value": "support-chat"}]. Types: string, number, datetime, boolean, stringOptions, arrayOptions (tags), stringObject (metadata, with key), null.

limit.description: Rows per page, default 50, at most 1000.

tools.name: langfuse_get_trace
tools.description: Read one Langfuse trace: all of its observations with input, output, model, token usage, cost and latency, newest first. The root observation has no parentObservationId and carries the trace's input and output.

from_start_time.description: Optional lower time bound (ISO 8601) to speed up the lookup.

cursor.description: meta.cursor of the previous page, for very long traces.

tools.name: langfuse_get_session
tools.description: Read one Langfuse session (for example a chat conversation): by default one row per trace, the entry point of each turn, with input, output and trace name, newest first. Set root_only false for every observation of the session.

session_id.description: Session id as set by the application.

root_only.description: true (default): one row per trace; false: every observation.

tools.name: langfuse_query_metrics
tools.description: Aggregate Langfuse data (Metrics API v2): counts, tokens, cost, latency percentiles or score values, grouped by dimensions such as model, trace name or prompt, optionally per minute, hour, day, week or month. Replaces the deprecated daily metrics endpoint.

query.description: The query as a JSON string: {"view": "observations", "metrics": [{"measure": "totalCost", "aggregation": "sum"}], "dimensions": [{"field": "providedModelName"}], "timeDimension": {"granularity": "day"}, "filters": [], "fromTimestamp": "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z", "toTimestamp": "2026-10-31T00:00:00Z"}. view, metrics, fromTimestamp and toTimestamp are required.

tools.name: langfuse_list_scores
tools.description: List Langfuse scores (evaluations, user feedback, annotations) newest first, with name, value, data type, source, comment and the trace, observation or session they belong to. Filters take comma-separated lists. Page with cursor = meta.cursor.

data_type.description: Data types, comma-separated: NUMERIC, BOOLEAN, CATEGORICAL, TEXT, CORRECTION.

session_id.description: Session ids, comma-separated (not together with trace_id).

value_min.description: Lowest numeric value, with data_type NUMERIC.

value_max.description: Highest numeric value, with data_type NUMERIC.

from_timestamp.description: Only scores at or after this ISO 8601 time.

to_timestamp.description: Only scores before this ISO 8601 time.

limit.description: Scores per page, default 50, at most 100.

tools.name: langfuse_create_score
tools.description: Add one score to a Langfuse trace, observation, session or experiment run, e.g. a quality rating or a correctness check. Processed asynchronously (HTTP 202). Pass the same score_id again to overwrite a score.

name.description: Score name, e.g. correctness or user-feedback.

value.description: The value: a number for NUMERIC, 0 or 1 for BOOLEAN, a string for CATEGORICAL and TEXT.

data_type.description: Data type; inferred from value when omitted.

observation_id.description: Observation the score belongs to (with trace_id).

dataset_run_id.description: Experiment (dataset run) the score belongs to.

config_id.description: Score config id from langfuse_list_score_configs; enforces its range or categories.

score_id.description: Your own id for the score, to update it later.

tools.name: langfuse_list_score_configs
tools.description: List the score configs of the Langfuse project: name, data type, numeric range or categories, description and whether archived.

tools.name: langfuse_list_prompts
tools.description: List the prompts of the Langfuse project: name, type, versions, labels, tags and last update. Filter by name, label or tag.

label.description: Only prompts with a version carrying this label, e.g. production.

from_updated_at.description: Only versions updated at or after this ISO 8601 time.

to_updated_at.description: Only versions updated before this ISO 8601 time.

tools.name: langfuse_get_prompt
tools.description: Read one Langfuse prompt version: its text or chat messages, config (model, temperature), labels, tags, version and commit message. Without version or label the version labelled production is returned.

prompt_name.description: Prompt name including any folder path, e.g. support/greeting.

label.description: A label such as production, staging or latest.

resolve.description: false returns prompt references unresolved; default true.

tools.name: langfuse_create_prompt_version
tools.description: Publish a new version of a Langfuse prompt (a new name creates the prompt). Text prompts take a string with {{variables}}, chat prompts a list of messages. Labels such as production change what applications fetch: confirm with the user before setting them.

name.description: Prompt name including any folder path, at most 255 characters.

prompt.description: For text: the prompt string, e.g. Summarise {{text}} in {{language}}. For chat: [{"role": "system", "content": "..."}, {"role": "user", "content": "{{question}}"}].

config.description: Free-form config stored with the version, e.g. {"model": "gpt-4o", "temperature": 0.2}.

labels.description: Labels for this version, e.g. ["staging"]; latest is set automatically.

tags.description: Tags for all versions of the prompt.

tools.name: langfuse_update_prompt_labels
tools.description: Set the deployment labels of one Langfuse prompt version, e.g. promote version 4 to production. A label moves away from the version that had it. Confirm with the user before moving production.

prompt_name.description: Prompt name including any folder path.

new_labels.description: Labels to put on this version, e.g. ["production"]. latest is reserved.

tools.name: langfuse_list_datasets
tools.description: List the datasets of the Langfuse project with id, name, description, metadata and dates.

tools.name: langfuse_get_dataset
tools.description: Read one Langfuse dataset by name: description, metadata, input and expected-output JSON schemas and dates.

dataset_name.description: Dataset name, including any folder path.

tools.name: langfuse_create_dataset
tools.description: Create a Langfuse dataset for evaluations and experiments, optionally with JSON schemas that every item's input and expected output must match.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema the items' input must match.

expected_output_schema.description: JSON Schema the items' expected output must match.

tools.name: langfuse_list_dataset_items
tools.description: List the items of Langfuse datasets: input, expected output, metadata, status (ACTIVE or ARCHIVED) and the trace or observation they came from. Filter by dataset or source; version shows a dataset as it was at a point in time.

source_trace_id.description: Only items created from this trace.

source_observation_id.description: Only items created from this observation.

version.description: ISO 8601 UTC time: items as they were then; needs dataset_name.

tools.name: langfuse_get_dataset_item
tools.description: Read one Langfuse dataset item: input, expected output, metadata, status, source trace and observation, dataset and dates.

tools.name: langfuse_upsert_dataset_item
tools.description: Add an item to a Langfuse dataset, or update it when item_id already exists: input, expected output, metadata, the source trace or observation, and status ARCHIVED to retire it.

input.description: Input of the test case: any JSON value.

source_trace_id.description: Trace the item was taken from.

source_observation_id.description: Observation the item was taken from.

item_id.description: Your own id; an existing id updates that item. Unique per project, at most 255 characters.

tools.name: langfuse_list_experiments
tools.description: List Langfuse experiments and dataset runs with recent activity first: name, dataset, metadata and, with fields scores, their aggregated scores. from_start_time is required. Page with cursor = meta.cursor.

from_start_time.description: Required lower bound: experiments with events at or after this ISO 8601 time.

fields.description: Field groups: core, metadata, scores. Default core,scores.
